نرتقي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَقِي (nartaqī) /nar.ta.qiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# نَرْتَقِيَ (nartaqiya) /nar.ta.qi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
